text:
sara: Customer AcmeGames (acct acme+trial@protonmail.com) signed up for free trial but it's on hold. Dashboard shows `trial_on_hold: risk_flags`. Promo code ACME2026 failed to apply. Can we get manual review/override?

triage-bot: automated risk scan -> score: 0.92; flags: vpn, disposable_email, ip_rotation, card_velocity. See /risk/lookup/acct_932 for details.

matt_ops: can you paste the signup headers and IPs? also which card token / last4 if available (masked ok).

sara: signup IPs: 89.160.45.12, 89.160.45.19 (same /28), geo looks like NL but billing address US. Email domain: protonmail.com (plus addressing acme+trial). Promo attempt: ACME2026 returned `promo.apply.blocked_risk`.

sara: curl of risk svc (redacted):
```
{
  "email": "acme+trial@protonmail.com",
  "ip": "89.160.45.12",
  "score": 0.92,
  "flags": ["vpn","temp_email","ip_rotation"]
}
```

ivan_risk: quick take — ASN belongs to an ISP that's commonly used by commercial VPN exit nodes (seen in our vpn_asn list). Protonmail + plus addressing is common but not definitive. Important: multiple signups from same /28 in last 12h and a non-matching billing country -> triggers our velocity and geo mismatch rules.

ivan_risk: if this is a legitimate enterprise customer we can do a manual override. Requirements: phone verification (record), copy of company domain or SOW, and a 30d monitoring tag. If CS confirms, we can grant a 7-day trial credit while we monitor.

julia_cs_mgr: I can approve a manual 7-day override only if CS confirms phone + legal domain or contract. Sara, did you get anything on the call?

sara: I called. Contact claims they're with Acme Games LLC, provided company domain acmegames.io and a signed PDF contract (attached in ticket). Phone # +1-415-555-0198 (verified). Billing card AVS mismatch noted but customer says they use payment processor in US.

matt_ops: OK. I'll run the admin grant with audit note once you confirm. Command I'll run (audit log attached to run):
```
admin grant-trial --user-id acct_932 --duration 7d --source manual_review --note "verified by phone + contract" --audit "manual override by juliacs"
```

ivan_risk: after grant, set account flag `monitor:enhanced` for 30d and enable token rate limits to low burst. I'll add high-fidelity checks to evals for any model requests coming from that account.

julia_cs_mgr: approved. Mark the ticket and include copies of the call recording + contract in the customer record.

sara: will attach recordings and run the admin grant now. Posting follow-up once done. :thumbsup:

matt_ops: grant applied, audit id GRANT-2026-998, promo still blocked (we don't auto-apply promo codes on manual grants). CS please apply promo manually if policy allows.

sara: noted — customer accepted 7-day trial via manual grant. Asked for promo ACME2026 to be applied as a goodwill credit; will escalate to billing if needed. Adding ticket note and closing this Slack thread. Thanks all. :heart:

ivan_risk: added monitoring tag and set 30d review reminder. Watch for three signals: new card token + geo change, high token generation, or rapid account creations from same IP range.

sara: closing thread — follow-ups on ticket.
